description: This file is a comprehensive documentation, overview, and specification description for the HDMIOutput HAL interface. It details the interface's purpose, implementation requirements, capabilities, event handling, data flow, system context, and platform capabilities, serving as a detailed design or technical reference document rather than executable code.

classes.name: Capabilities
classes.description: Describes the features and supported modes, formats, colorimetry, HDCP, HDR, and InfoFrame capabilities of an HDMI output port.

classes.name: HDCPStatus
classes.description: Enumeration representing HDCP authentication states (e.g., authenticated, unauthenticated, failure).

classes.name: HDROutputMode
classes.description: Enumeration for HDR output modes such as AUTO, HDR10, HLG, Dolby Vision.

classes.name: SPDSource
classes.description: Enumeration for sources providing Source Product Description InfoFrame.

classes.name: VIC
classes.description: Enumeration of HDMI Video ID Codes for various resolutions and timings.

methods.name: getCapabilities
methods.description: Retrieves the capabilities of a specific HDMI output port, including supported modes, formats, and features.

methods.name: setProperty
methods.description: Configures output properties such as VIC, content type, AFD, HDR mode, etc., for a specific HDMI port.

methods.name: getHDCPCurrentVersion
methods.description: Returns the current HDCP protocol version active on the port.

methods.name: getHDCPReceiverVersion
methods.description: Returns the HDCP version supported by the connected sink device.
